about_the_game:
Welcome to Viceria, a strategic colony simulator where you take on the role of a governor appointed by the crown. Your task is to turn wild lands into prosperous estates, managing resources, developing the economy, building trade and strengthening defences.

But the road to greatness is not easy: you will have to decide the fate of settlers, find a balance between the interests of the colony and the orders of the metropolis, cope with rebellions, epidemics, natural disasters and complex relations with the indigenous population.

Are you a loyal servant of the crown or a would-be revolutionary? Will you follow orders or lead a rebellion for independence? In Viceria, every choice has consequences, and history is written by your decisions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2+ Cores, 2+ GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 256 MB
  • Storage: 512 MB available space

short_description: Viceria is a minimalistic colony simulator. Build cities, develop your economy, build trade, defend your colony from threats and decide the fate of your people. Will you serve the metropolis or will you oppose it? It's up to you!
supported_languages: English, Russian, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Hungarian, Greek, Danish, Indonesian, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Turkish, Ukrainian, Finnish, Czech, Swedish, Japanese
